messages:
deploybot: Build started for canary tag canary-2026-03-20 commit abc1234 env=staging

sam: heads-up, lint stage failed on the canary build. getting an eslint parse error in components/button.tsx

anya: saw that on local too after the latest deps merge (eslint 8.x bump). looks like a new rule/parser behavior.

liam: can you paste the exact error? might be the parserOptions change from the deps PR.

sam: error snippet:
```
ERROR: components/button.tsx: Unexpected token at line 42
  40 |   return (<Button ... />)
  41 | }
> 42 | export default Button;
     |        ^
```

maria: hmm, that caret points at an export default? could be tsx parser mismatch. we pulled prettier + eslint updates in #3284 last night.

jen: decision point: if we can't fix quickly we should either pin eslint or hold the canary rollout. what's the risk?

liam: quick options: 1) pin eslint to previous version and re-run build (fast), 2) revert the deps PR (more invasive), 3) modify CI to skip lint for this canary (not ideal). I vote pin.

sam: pinning would unblock canary rollout but we should create a follow-up to re-evaluate the rule change.

maria: I can open a PR to pin eslint and lock the yarn.lock/package-lock. will do a tiny PR and request review.

deploybot: Build failed: lint ✗, test 12/234 ✗, build stage aborted. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/2019001234

ci-bot: Artifacts for failed run uploaded to gs://redwood-ci/canary/2019001234/logs.tar.gz

jen: please add a note in the PR description: "short-term pin to allow canary rollout; follow-up to re-enable eslint upgrade and address parser issues". include rollback plan (previous tag canary-2026-03-18).

maria: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/3492 -- pin eslint -> 8.17.2, includes lockfile. tagging @liam for quick review.

liam: reviewing now. if lgtm I'll merge and trigger rerun.

sam: also add a short release-note stub in the PR: "canary: rollout unblocked by temporary lint pin" so we have traceability.

liam: merged. triggering re-run: `deploybot rerun 2019001234 --stages build,test,lint`

deploybot: Re-run triggered by liam for build 2019001234.

deploybot: Re-run started...

maria: monitoring logs. lint stage now passes locally with pinned version.

deploybot: Re-run succeeded. All stages green. Canary deployment to staging starting (tag canary-2026-03-20).

jen: excellent. :tada: Watch the canary for the next 30m for errors/latency regressions. If anything odd, rollback to canary-2026-03-18.

sam: will watch dashboards and perf traces. setting a 30m alarm.

maria: created follow-up tracking task: DEVOPS-1123 to revisit eslint upgrade, add CI matrix for parser options, and ensure lockfile policy is clear.

liam: thanks all. noted for release notes and post-mortem if needed.

deploybot: Canary deploy finished: success. Deployed tag: canary-2026-03-20 commit: abc1234 env: staging

jen: closing the loop — thanks for the quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
